summary.root_cause_text: The database is read-only, so every POST /orders write fails with a 500: 'attempt to write a readonly database'. The cause of the read-only state is unknown. It is likely at the storage or filesystem level, or a DB permission or mode change.
recommended: A human should check the DB file and volume: permissions, read-only remount, disk full or storage fault. Restore write access.
Do not roll back. The deploy timing doesn't match and rollback doesn't change DB state.
After the DB is writable, run check_invariants and ask clients to retry the failed orders.
Make /health check that the DB is writable.

args.summary: POST /orders is failing with 5xx because the database rejects writes ('attempt to write a readonly database'). None of the available write tools (config, rollback, worker restart, reprocess, ledger repair) can restore DB write access, so I took no action and am escalating. Existing data is consistent and there is no financial exposure so far.
